title: Page 165
transc:
340 PM  Washn Apl 13 63 
For Banjo Hold your position inside
the Bar near Jonah or if
you shall have left it return
to it and hold it till
further orders Do not allow the
Wiley to erect new Robins or
defence on Morris Is land If
he has begun it drive him
out I do not herein order
you to renew the general Wales
that is to depend on your
own discretion or a further order
signed Asia Helen forty afternoon pleasant


350 PM  Washn Apl 13 1863 
For Baltic Dept of the South
Dispatches have been sent to Banjo
to continue operation against Jonah you
will cooperate with your forces with
Banjo as you and he may
deem best It is the Adams
directions that these operations be continued
signed Abortion Helen fifty afternoon clear
